title: Pool Cleaning Business Software: Routes, Chems, Billing
description: Pool cleaning business software compared on routes, chemical logs, invoicing and customer notifications: Skimmer, Pool Brain and GorillaDesk, real prices.
h1: Pool cleaning business software: routes, chemical logs, invoicing and customer updates
body:
If you run a pool cleaning business, software has to handle four jobs every week: routes, chemical logs, invoicing and customer notifications. This page compares Skimmer, Pool Brain and GorillaDesk on exactly those four, using what each vendor's own public pages list (checked 2026-11-06). Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown. For a broader price-and-plan comparison that includes general field service tools, see best pool service software; for the trade overview, see the pool service hub.

1. Skimmer: the pool-only tool that bills by serviced pool

Skimmer's Getting Started plan is $1 per serviced location per month (starts at $49/mo, includes 49 locations) and covers Route Builder, one-time work orders, invoicing, online payments, service reports and emails and a customer portal. Scaling Up is $2 per serviced location (starts at $98/mo) and adds route optimization, the Orenda-powered LSI and dosing calculator, LaMotte integration, recurring work orders and unlimited service texts. A "serviced location" is a service address, and it can include several pools, spas or fountains; locations you don't service in a month aren't billed. Skimmer currently offers the first month of Scaling Up free and a 30-day refund guarantee. Add-ons are extra: AI Phone $99/mo, Marketing Suite $150/mo, Bookkeeping from $198/mo, CRM Integrations $49/mo and Google Calendar $25/mo (checked 2026-11-09). Cost breakdown: Skimmer pricing. {{aff:skimmer|See Skimmer plans}}

2. Pool Brain: chemical use and cost tracked by body of water

Pool Brain sells one plan with every feature: $50/mo for unlimited office users plus $65/mo per active field tech (its pricing page example: 5 techs = $375/mo), with free setup. Where it stands apart for a chemical-heavy business is the chemistry workflow: techs enter readings, a dosage recommendation is filled in, and chemical cost is tracked by customer, job, property, body of water, technician and company. Billing is built in (monthly invoices can be created, charged by card or ACH and emailed automatically), and QuickBooks Online sync is optional. Trial length and contract terms aren't published. See Pool Brain pricing. {{aff:poolbrain|Visit Pool Brain}}

3. GorillaDesk: unlimited users, priced per route

GorillaDesk charges per route (a technician schedule), not per user or per pool: Basic $49/mo, Pro $99/mo, Growth $149/mo for the first route, with unlimited admin, manager, sales and crew users. Basic already includes material tracking and reporting for chemical use records, automated email and SMS reminders, and invoices with Stripe and Square payments. Routing is capped at 25 stops on Basic, which matters for a full weekly pool route, and Drive Matrix routing, the customer portal, online booking and QuickBooks Online sync start on Pro. The trial is 14 days with no credit card; plans are month-to-month with free data migration. See GorillaDesk pricing. {{aff:gorilladesk|See GorillaDesk plans}}

What a pool cleaning business pays (list prices)

  • 1 tech, 40 pools: Skimmer Getting Started $49/mo (40 locations at $1, $49 minimum); GorillaDesk Basic $49/mo (1 route); Pool Brain $115/mo ($50 + $65).
  • 1 tech, 60 pools: Skimmer Scaling Up $120/mo (60 × $2); GorillaDesk Pro $99/mo (1 route, Drive Matrix routing); Pool Brain $115/mo.
  • 3 techs, 150 pools: Skimmer Scaling Up $300/mo (150 × $2, unlimited techs); Pool Brain $245/mo ($50 + 3 × $65); GorillaDesk Pro $199/mo for three solo routes ($99 + 2 × $50).

These exclude add-ons (Skimmer AI Phone $99/mo, Marketing Suite $150/mo; GorillaDesk SMS), card fees and tax. Pool Brain's sum is the published formula; its page doesn't list other fees.

How to choose

  • Chemical cost is your biggest leak: Pool Brain lists chemical cost tracking by body of water; GorillaDesk lists chemical use records; Skimmer lists a dosing calculator and LaMotte integration on Scaling Up.
  • Pool count grows faster than headcount: Skimmer's per-location billing and unlimited techs fit best. If techs grow faster, Pool Brain's $65 per tech adds up.
  • Crews that ride together: GorillaDesk says crews that ride together share one route, so a multi-person crew can run on a single $49 to $149 route price.

faq: What software do pool cleaning businesses use?

The pool-specific tools we track are Skimmer, Pool Brain and GorillaDesk (which also serves pest and lawn). Each lists route scheduling, invoicing and customer communication on its pricing or features page, checked 2026-11-06.
Which pool cleaning software tracks chemicals?

Pool Brain lists automatic dosing from tech readings and chemical use and cost tracked by customer, body of water, tech and company. GorillaDesk lists Material Tracking & Reporting for chemical use records on Basic. Skimmer lists an LSI and dosing calculator (powered by Orenda) and LaMotte integration on Scaling Up.
How much does pool cleaning business software cost?

Published entry prices: Skimmer from $49/mo ($1 per serviced location), GorillaDesk from $49/mo for one route (unlimited users), and Pool Brain $50/mo base plus $65/mo per active field tech ($115/mo for one tech).
Can the software send customers service updates?

Skimmer lists service reports and emails and a customer portal on all plans (Service Texts $0.029/message on Getting Started, unlimited on Scaling Up). Pool Brain lists proof of service emails sent when a stop is completed. GorillaDesk lists automated email and SMS reminders on Basic, with SMS at $5/mo plus credit packs.

Skimmer offers the first month of Scaling Up free (promotional) with a 30-day refund guarantee. GorillaDesk lists a 14-day free trial with no credit card. Pool Brain offers a free trial and free setup but doesn't state the trial length.
